definitions.gloss: route map; transit map; network map
definitions.explanation: A diagram showing the routes of trains, buses, or other transportation lines. Especially common for railway and subway systems in Japan.

examples.english: I look at the route map.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{路線図|ろせんず}で{乗|の}り{換|か}えを{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the transfer on the route map at the station.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}の{地下鉄|ちかてつ}の{路線図|ろせんず}は{複雑|ふくざつ}で、{初|はじ}めて{見|み}ると{迷|まよ}ってしまう。
examples.english: Tokyo's subway route map is so complicated that you get confused when you see it for the first time.

notes:
USAGE: {路線図|ろせんず} is commonly found at train stations and bus stops throughout Japan. It shows the network of lines with station names and connection points.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路線図|ろせんず}を{見|み}る: to look at a route map
- {地下鉄|ちかてつ}の{路線図|ろせんず}: subway route map
- {鉄道|てつどう}{路線図|ろせんず}: railway network map
- バス{路線図|ろせんず}: bus route map

The word is a compound of {路線|ろせん} (route, line) and {図|ず} (diagram, map).
